notice: ISS medical kit list (NASA 3.001, SpX-6, 09 APR 15)
source: Built from "medical_kit_checklist_-_full_release (1).pdf" in this project: tables 1, 2, 8 and 10 (the medication packs). Strengths, side effects and comments are copied from that document. Check against your mission's current approved list before real use.

medicines.name: Bacitracin
medicines.sideEffects: No significant side effects

medicines.name: Loperamide (Imodium)
medicines.sideEffects: Abdominal discomfort, nausea, vomiting, constipation, drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth
medicines.comments: Use for nonbloody diarrhea. No more than 8 tablets every 24 hours.

medicines.name: Fexofenadine (Allegra)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, vomiting, fatigue, somnolence, dizziness, fever, pain, drowsiness, diarrhea, nausea, upset stomach, muscle aches, back pain, pain in extremities
medicines.comments: Do not use with other antihistamines. Do not drink grapefruit juice 1 hour before or 2 hours after taking the medication.

medicines.name: Loratadine (Claritin)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, drowsiness, dizziness, fatigue, dry mouth

medicines.name: Olopatadine (Pataday)
medicines.sideEffects: Blurred vision, eye pain, stinging, burning, headache
medicines.comments: Remove contact lenses before use. After instilling drops, wait at least 10 minutes before inserting contact lenses.

medicines.name: Oxymetazoline (Afrin)
medicines.sideEffects: Transient burning, stinging, dryness of the nasal mucosa, sneezing, cough
medicines.comments: Do not use more than 3 consecutive days. Rebound congestion with prolonged use.

medicines.name: Pseudoephedrine (Sudafed 12 Hour)
medicines.sideEffects: Dizziness, rapid heart rate, high blood pressure, restlessness, tremor, headache, loss of appetite, may impair ability to concentrate, dry mouth, insomnia, photosensitivity

medicines.name: Carboxymethylcellulose (Refresh Plus)
medicines.sideEffects: Temporary blurred vision

medicines.name: Hypromellose (Nature’s Tears)
medicines.sideEffects: Temporary blurred vision
medicines.comments: Remove contact lenses prior to use.

medicines.name: Mineral Oil and White Petrolatum (Refresh PM)
medicines.sideEffects: Temporary blurred vision

medicines.name: Sodium Chloride (AYR Saline)
medicines.sideEffects: No significant side effects within prescribed dose

medicines.name: Acetaminophen (Tylenol)
medicines.sideEffects: No significant side effects within prescribed dose
medicines.comments: No more than 12 tablets every 24 hours.

medicines.name: Aspirin
medicines.sideEffects: Upset stomach, dizziness, ringing in ears, blood in stool
medicines.comments: Take with food.

medicines.name: Ibuprofen (Motrin)
medicines.sideEffects: Dizziness, nervousness, upset stomach, nausea, vomiting, rash, ringing in the ears
medicines.comments: No more than 8 tablets every 24 hours. Take with food.

medicines.name: Melatonin
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, nausea, drowsiness, dizziness
medicines.comments: Do not use with other sleep meds.

medicines.name: Zaleplon (Sonata)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, dizziness, drowsiness, short-term memory impairment, or lack of coordination, nausea, upset stomach, muscle weakness
medicines.comments: Do not take with a high fat meal. Do not use with other sleep meds.

medicines.name: Zolpidem (Ambien)
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, dizziness, headache, abnormal dreams, insomnia, memory impairment, visual and attention disturbance
medicines.comments: Do not use with other sleep meds.

medicines.name: Hydrocortisone
medicines.sideEffects: No significant side effects

medicines.name: Mometasone (Nasonex)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, cough

medicines.name: Caffeine (Vivarin)
medicines.sideEffects: Diarrhea, dizziness, fast heartbeat, low blood sugar, high blood sugar, blurred vision, dry mouth, flushed skin, increased urination, loss of appetite, nausea, stomachache, anxious feeling, agitation, cold sweats, nervousness, insomnia

medicines.name: Modafinil (Provigil)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, nervousness, dizziness, anxiety, insomnia, chest pain, rapid heart rate, diarrhea, upset stomach, dry mouth, lack of appetite

medicines.name: Bisacodyl (Dulcolax)
medicines.sideEffects: Mild abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, dizziness

medicines.name: Atropine
medicines.sideEffects: Rapid heart rate, dilated pupils, dry skin and mouth, cardiac arrhythmias, flushing, low blood pressure, headache, insomnia, slowed GI motility, nausea, dry mouth, urinary hesitancy and retention

medicines.name: Epinephrine
medicines.sideEffects: Rapid heart rate and palpitations, flushing, dizziness, headache, nervousness, dry mouth

medicines.name: Lidocaine
medicines.sideEffects: Low blood pressure, flushing, drowsiness, disorientation, muscle twitching, dizziness, metallic taste, nausea, vomiting

medicines.name: Epinephrine (EpiPen)
medicines.sideEffects: Rapid heart rate and palpitations, flushing, dizziness, headache, nervousness, dry mouth

medicines.name: Acetazolamide (Diamox)
medicines.sideEffects: Flushing, tingling sensation in extremities, loss of appetite, increased urine output, drowsiness, dizziness, confusion, photosensitivity, hearing disturbances, kidney stones

medicines.name: Amoxicillin (Amoxil)
medicines.sideEffects: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, rash

medicines.name: Azithromycin (Zithromax)
medicines.sideEffects: Diarrhea, nausea, abdominal pain, vomiting

medicines.name: Clindamycin (Cleocin)
medicines.sideEffects: Abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, rash

medicines.name: Doxycycline (Vibramycin)
medicines.sideEffects: Diarrhea, severe headache, blurred vision, skin rash, redness of the skin (sunburn), itching, loss of appetite, upset stomach, stomach pain, extreme tiredness or weakness, confusion, decreased urination

medicines.name: Levofloxacin (Levaquin)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, insomnia, dizziness, nausea, constipation, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, rash, photosensitivity

medicines.name: Metronidazole (Flagyl)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, metallic taste, rash
medicines.comments: Take with food.

medicines.name: Sulfamethoxazole and Trimethoprim (Bactrim DS)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, dizziness, insomnia, stomach upset, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, photosensitivity, rash

medicines.name: Fluconazole (Diflucan)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, dizziness, nausea, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, rash

medicines.name: Diphenhydramine (Benadryl)
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, sedation, inability to concentrate, dry mouth, blurred vision, rash, headache, rapid heart rate, dizziness, fatigue, photosensitivity, urinary retention, ringing in the ears, nasal stuffiness
medicines.comments: May cause sedation and impair performance. Do not use with sleep meds.

medicines.name: Fexofenadine (Allegra)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, vomiting, fatigue, somnolence, dizziness, fever, pain, drowsiness, diarrhea, nausea, upset stomach, muscle aches, back pain, pain in extremities
medicines.comments: Do not use with other antihistamines. Do not drink grapefruit juice 1 hour before or 2 hours after taking the medication.

medicines.name: Phenytoin (Dilantin ER)
medicines.sideEffects: Tingling sensation in extremities, drowsiness, dizziness, blurred vision, slurred speech
medicines.comments: Swallow whole; do not crush or chew.

medicines.name: Valacyclovir (Valtrex)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, dizziness, rash

medicines.name: Aripiprazole (Abilify)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, agitation, insomnia, anxiety, tremor, restlessness, sedation, dizziness, nausea, constipation, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, dry mouth, blurred vision, nasal congestion

medicines.name: Lorazepam (Ativan)
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, slowed breathing, low blood pressure, sedation, dizziness, headache, memory impairment, nausea, changes in appetite, visual disturbances, headache

medicines.name: Sertraline (Zoloft)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, drowsiness, dizziness, insomnia, nervousness, anxiety, nausea, dry mouth, loss of appetite, constipation, tremor, weakness, visual difficulty, sweating, rash, tinnitus

medicines.name: Venlafaxine (Effexor XR)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, drowsiness, dizziness, insomnia, nervousness, anxiety, nausea, dry mouth, loss of appetite, constipation, weakness, sweating
medicines.comments: Swallow whole; do not crush or chew.

medicines.name: Lisinopril (Zestril)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, low blood pressure, dizziness, fatigue, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, cough, blurred vision, decrease in urine output or urine-concentrating ability, sweating, weakness

medicines.name: Metoprolol XL (Toprol XL)
medicines.sideEffects: Slow heart rate, dizziness, weakness, insomnia, diarrhea, blurred vision, shortness of breath, fatigue, confusion, memory loss (short-term), sleep disturbances, rash, itching, photosensitivity
medicines.comments: Swallow whole; do not crush or chew.

medicines.name: Nitroglycerin (Nitrostat)
medicines.sideEffects: Flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, dry mouth

medicines.name: Pseudoephedrine (Sudafed)
medicines.sideEffects: Dizziness, rapid heart rate, high blood pressure, restlessness, tremor, headache, loss of appetite, may impair ability to concentrate, dry mouth, insomnia, photosensitivity

medicines.name: Medroxyprogesterone (Provera)
medicines.sideEffects: Dizziness, headache, nervousness, bloating, acne, breast pain

medicines.name: Norgestrel and Ethinyl Estradiol (Ogestrel)
medicines.sideEffects: Elevated blood pressure, headache, dizziness, nervousness, nausea, abdominal cramps, blood clots, appetite changes, bloating, breast pain

medicines.name: Hydrocodone and Acetaminophen (Vicodin HP)
medicines.sideEffects: Slower heart rate, dizziness, drowsiness, mental impairment, sedation, nausea, vomiting, constipation, urinary retention
medicines.comments: May cause sedation and impair performance. Do not use with sleep meds.

medicines.name: Meclizine (Antivert)
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, headache, fatigue, nervousness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision
medicines.comments: May cause sedation and impair performance. Do not use with sleep meds.

medicines.name: Ondansetron (Zofran ODT)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, fatigue, drowsiness, dizziness, anxiety, constipation, diarrhea, urinary retention, itching

medicines.name: Promethazine (Phenergan)
medicines.sideEffects: Sedation, inability to concentrate, drowsiness, dizziness, blurred or double vision, nausea, dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, rash, agitation, photosensitivity, uncontrolled muscle spasms
medicines.comments: May cause sedation and impair performance. Do not use with sleep meds.

medicines.name: Methylprednisolone (Medrol)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, dizziness, insomnia, restlessness, depression, anxiety, sweating, mood changes, hair growth, flushing, acne

medicines.name: Prednisone (Deltasone)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, fluid retention, vertigo, high blood pressure, mood changes
medicines.comments: Take with food.

medicines.name: Modafinil (Provigil)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, nervousness, dizziness, anxiety, insomnia, chest pain, rapid heart rate, diarrhea, upset stomach, dry mouth, lack of appetite

medicines.name: Bismuth Subsalicylate (Pepto Bismol)
medicines.sideEffects: May darken tongue and stool.

medicines.name: Omeprazole (Prilosec)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, dizziness, rash, flatulence, diarrhea, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, constipation, joint pain

medicines.name: Ranitidine (Zantac)
medicines.sideEffects: Dizziness, headache, insomnia, abdominal discomfort, blurred vision

medicines.name: Tamsulosin (Flomax)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, dizziness, drowsiness, diarrhea, nausea, weakness, back pain, blurred vision, inflammation of the nasal membranes, runny nose, cough

medicines.name: Benzocaine Swabstick
medicines.sideEffects: No significant side effects

medicines.name: Tetracaine
medicines.sideEffects: Burning, stinging, redness of the eye, light sensitivity, tearing
medicines.comments: Remove contact lenses prior to administration and wait 15 minutes before reinserting.

medicines.name: Lidocaine and Epinephrine (Xylocaine and Epinephrine)
medicines.sideEffects: Burning, stinging, blanching, tissue death

medicines.name: Lidocaine (Xylocaine)
medicines.sideEffects: Burning, stinging, blanching, tissue death

medicines.name: Lidocaine Jelly
medicines.sideEffects: Irritation, itching, rash

medicines.name: Bacitracin
medicines.sideEffects: No significant side effects

medicines.name: Ceftriaxone (Rocephin)
medicines.sideEffects: Thickening of tissue at injection site, rash, diarrhea

medicines.name: Ciprofloxacin and Dexamethasone (Ciprodex)
medicines.sideEffects: Ear discomfort, ear pain, ear itching

medicines.name: Ertapenem (Invanz)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, altered mental status, insomnia, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, cough

medicines.name: Erythromycin
medicines.sideEffects: Hypersensitivity, minor eye irritation, redness

medicines.name: Moxifloxacin (Vigamox)
medicines.sideEffects: Dry eye, eye pain, itching eye, tearing, visual acuity decreased
medicines.comments: Contact lenses should not be worn during therapy.

medicines.name: Mupirocin (Bactroban)
medicines.sideEffects: Skin irritation, itching

medicines.name: Tobramycin and Dexamethasone (Tobradex)
medicines.sideEffects: Eye redness, increased intraocular pressure, tearing, lid itching, lid swelling
medicines.comments: Contact lenses should not be worn during therapy.

medicines.name: Clotrimazole (Lotrimin)
medicines.sideEffects: Skin irritation, itching

medicines.name: Cromolyn (Nasalcrom)
medicines.sideEffects: Increase in sneezing, burning, stinging or irritation inside the nose, headache, unpleasant taste, hoarseness, cough, post-nasal drip

medicines.name: Diphenhydramine (Benadryl)
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, sedation, inability to concentrate, dry mouth, blurred vision, rash, headache, rapid heart rate, dizziness, fatigue, photosensitivity, urinary retention, ringing in the ears, nasal stuffiness
medicines.comments: May cause sedation and impair performance. Do not take with sleep meds.

medicines.name: Aripiprazole (Abilify)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, agitation, insomnia, anxiety, tremor, restlessness, sedation, dizziness, nausea, constipation, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, dry mouth, blurred vision, nasal congestion

medicines.name: Diazepam (Valium)
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, fatigue, headache, memory loss, confusion, slurred speech, slower breathing rate, nausea, slow heart rate, blurred vision, constipation, dry mouth, urinary retention

medicines.name: Albuterol (Proventil HFA)
medicines.sideEffects: Tremors, palpitations, fast heart rate, dizziness, nervousness

medicines.name: Fluticasone (Flovent HFA)
medicines.sideEffects: Fatigue, headache, throat irritation, oral yeast infection, cough, hoarseness, abdominal discomfort, nausea, vomiting, muscle pain, rash, itching

medicines.name: Salmeterol (Serevent)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, muscle pain, high blood pressure, dizziness, sleep disturbance, anxiety, rash, throat irritation, nausea, dry mouth

medicines.name: Eugenol
medicines.sideEffects: Gum and skin irritation
medicines.comments: Warning: DO NOT swallow. Medication is very damaging to the esophagus and stomach. Precaution: Do not pour the entire syringe into mouth at once. Use small amounts in increments.

medicines.name: Carbamide Peroxide (Debrox)
medicines.sideEffects: Irritation, redness in the ear

medicines.name: Cyclopentolate (Cyclogyl)
medicines.sideEffects: Transient irritation, blurred vision, sensitivity to light, increased intraocular pressure
medicines.comments: Remove contact lenses prior to administration and wait 15 minutes before reinserting.

medicines.name: Fluorescein Strip
medicines.sideEffects: No significant side effects
medicines.comments: Remove contact lenses before using.

medicines.name: Tropicamide (Mydriacyl)
medicines.sideEffects: Blurred vision, burning, temporary stinging, increased intraocular pressure; dry mouth, headache, light sensitivity
medicines.comments: Remove contact lenses before using.

medicines.name: Glycopyrrolate (Robinul)
medicines.sideEffects: Flushing, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, fast heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, constipation, loss of taste, dry mouth, blurred vision, urinary retention, photosensitivity
medicines.comments: For use by Physician CMO Only

medicines.name: Ketamine (Ketalar)
medicines.sideEffects: Cardiac arrhythmia, visual hallucinations, vivid dreams, confusion, increased intraocular pressure, increased intracranial pressure, nausea, vomiting, increased salivation
medicines.comments: For use by Physician CMO Only

medicines.name: Hydromorphone (Dilaudid)
medicines.sideEffects: Drowsiness, dizziness, fatigue, headache, sedation, nausea, slow heart rate, blurred vision, nausea, vomiting, constipation, dry mouth, tinnitus, urinary retention, abnormal dreams, agitation, mood
medicines.comments: May cause sedation and impair performance. Do not use with sleep meds.

medicines.name: Ketorolac (Toradol)
medicines.sideEffects: Headache, nausea, upset stomach, diarrhea, dizziness, drowsiness, elevated blood pressure, swelling

medicines.name: Promethazine (Phenergan)
medicines.sideEffects: Sedation, inability to concentrate, drowsiness, dizziness, blurred or double vision, nausea, dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, rash, agitation, photosensitivity, uncontrolled muscle spasms
medicines.comments: May cause sedation and impair performance.

medicines.name: Dexamethasone (Decadron)
medicines.sideEffects: High blood pressure, slow heart rate, headache, vertigo, insomnia, mood swings, increased intraocular pressure

medicines.name: Fluocinonide (Lidex)
medicines.sideEffects: Skin irritation, itching

medicines.name: Silver Nitrate and Potassium Nitrate (Silver Nitrate Applicators)
medicines.sideEffects: Burning and skin irritation, staining of the skin

medicines.name: Cyanoacrylate (Dermabond)
medicines.sideEffects: Skin irritation, itching
